findings.title: Scope of Work and Deliverables Defined
findings.rationale: The evidence clearly outlines the products and services that fall under the agreement, which constitutes the scope of work.
evidence_excerpts: The following products and services fall under this Agreement: Enterprise Servers (Rack-mounted, Blade, Tower), Networking Equipment (Switches, Firewalls, Routers), Data Storage Solutions (NAS, SAN, Cloud-integrated Storage), Workstation and Peripheral Devices (UPS, Printers, Scanners, Monitors), Consumables (Cables, Batteries, Connectors), Extended Warranty and Maintenance Services.

findings.title: Payment Terms Defined
findings.rationale: The evidence clearly outlines the payment terms, including the advance payment and the timeline for the remaining payment after delivery.
evidence_excerpts: Client shall pay 50% advance upon purchase order confirmation and the remaining 50% within 30 days after delivery and acceptance.

findings.title: Late Payment Penalties
findings.rationale: The contract specifies that late payments will incur interest charges, which directly addresses the topic of late payment penalties.
evidence_excerpts: Late payments shall accrue interest at 1.25% per month.

findings.title: Pricing Structure Defined
findings.rationale: The agreement clearly outlines the pricing structure, including base prices, discounts, and payment terms.
evidence_excerpts: This Agreement defines the pricing, terms, and conditions applicable to the supply of electronic hardware products, accessories, and support services to Client.

findings.title: Price Revision Clause Present
findings.rationale: The agreement includes a clause that allows for price revisions based on changes in raw material costs, inflation, or regulatory requirements, indicating a form of price escalation mechanism.
evidence_excerpts: Prices may be reviewed semi-annually to reflect changes in raw material costs, inflation, or regulatory requirements.

findings.title: Termination for Convenience Notice Period
findings.rationale: The contract specifies the notice period required for termination without cause.
evidence_excerpts: Either party may terminate by providing 60 days’ prior written notice.

findings.title: Intellectual Property Ownership
findings.rationale: The Vendor retains all intellectual property rights over hardware design, firmware, and proprietary software, indicating that the Vendor owns the intellectual property created under this agreement.
evidence_excerpts: Vendor retains all intellectual property rights over hardware design, firmware, and proprietary software.

findings.title: Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
findings.rationale: The evidence explicitly states the governing law and the method for resolving disputes, which is arbitration under the Indian Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.
evidence_excerpts: Unresolved disputes will be referred to arbitration under the Indian Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. Arbitration proceedings will take place in [City, State], India, in English.
